description.value: Cycle City is a downtown Vancouver cycling institution operating two adjacent storefronts on Hornby Street — one for guided tours and one for rentals, repairs, and bike sales — rated #1 on TripAdvisor for Vancouver sightseeing with over 7,125 reviews. The shop carries top bicycle brands including Specialized and provides professional tune-ups and repairs with quick turn-around times, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical support. Beyond repairs, the operation offers a large rental fleet spanning city cruisers, e-bikes, performance road and gravel bikes, multiple guided tour formats, self-guided route maps, and luggage storage.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (30 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 76m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m; stands (5 spaces) at 85m; stands (4 spaces) at 94m; stands (10 spaces) at 98m. Total: 53 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and rich; it confirms an active bike shop, rental, and tour operation at 646/648 Hornby Street in downtown Vancouver with phone 604-618-8626. The repairs section explicitly states 'quick, professional bike tune-ups and repairs' and 'knowledgeable staff and quick turn-around times in our service department,' supporting the staff mechanical help criterion and walk-in repair claim. Bike rentals (e-bikes, road, gravel, kids, city cruisers) and guided tours are extensively documented across multiple subpages, while amenities like pump availability, washrooms, and DIY stands are not mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM record lists business as 'Cycle City' but the website and TripAdvisor listing use 'Cycle City Vancouver' as the operating name.
OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from website content only and could not be cross-checked against OSM values.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cycle City is a highly-rated, centrally located Vancouver bike shop offering repairs, a large rental fleet, and guided tours — a clear and strong fit for the WWC directory for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates two adjacent storefronts: 646 Hornby Street for rentals, repairs, and sales; 648 Hornby Street for bike tours and administration. Luggage storage is also offered as a standalone service.

Bike rentals.detail: Hundreds of bikes including city cruisers, e-bikes, kids bikes, performance road bikes (Specialized Allez Comp, Roubaix SL8 Pro), and gravel bikes (Specialized Diverge Expert Carbon); all rentals include helmet, lock, basket/handlebar bag, and map

Guided rides.detail: Multiple guided tour options: Grand Bike Tour, Stanley Park Bike Tour, Family Stanley Park Bike Tour, Epic Electric Bike Tour, and group/private tours with 'story-teller guides'

Touring parts stocked.detail: Product catalog includes panniers, handlebar bags, frame bags, saddlebags, front racks, rear racks, fenders, and computers/mounts — core touring accessories

wow_evidence: rated #1 on TripAdvisor for Vancouver sightseeing with over 7,125 reviews
